title: Triage from the keyboard
criterion: j/k/x/m/e/Backspace/Escape/? behave as specified; negative: no effect while typing in the composer, search or edit box, while a menu/dialog is open, or with Cmd/Ctrl/Alt.
prerequisites: Google Chrome and Node 22+. Demo data only; no account or network needed.
note: One run of check.mjs evaluates every UI Oracle; this one passes when its section of the report meets the bar.
